Dot Matrix

Source: R/figure-plots-matrices.R
PlotDotMatrix.Rd

One dot per row and column, its area growing with one measure (for example the percentage of positive cells, as a figure scatter area area[1] + area[2] * size in points squared) and its colour showing a second (for example a z-scored signal on a diverging scale). Rows without any value are dropped. Thin grid lines run through the dots and a light frame surrounds the matrix; row annotation boxes, a colour bar and a size key can be added outside it.

Usage

PlotDotMatrix(
  data,
  row = "row",
  column = "column",
  size = "size",
  signal = "signal",
  rows = NULL,
  columns = NULL,
  row_labels = NULL,
  column_labels = NULL,
  area = c(2, 0.55),
  scale = "rdbu_r",
  limits = c(-3, 3),
  edge_colour = "#777777",
  edge_width = 0.25,
  grid_colour = "#F0F0F0",
  grid_width = 0.5,
  frame_colour = "#BBBBBB",
  frame_width = 0.4,
  pad = 0.1,
  row_colours = NULL,
  row_box = c(-1.05, 0.35, 0.76),
  column_angle = 55,
  column_size = 5.1,
  column_pad = 3.5,
  row_size = 5.3,
  row_pad = 9,
  colourbar = NULL,
  size_key = NULL,
  texts = NULL,
  values = NULL,
  style = ManuscriptStyle()
)

Arguments

data

Long data: one row per matrix cell.

row, column

Columns with the row and column keys.

size, signal

Columns with the size and colour measures.

rows, columns

Row order (top to bottom) and column order (left to right): character vectors or data frames (ordered by a rank column if present); default first appearance.

row_labels, column_labels

Display labels: named mapping or vector.

area

Scatter area c(intercept, slope) in squared points.

scale

Colour scale name or vector of anchor colours.

limits

Colour limits; values are clipped to them.

edge_colour, edge_width

Dot outline colour and width (points).

grid_colour, grid_width

Grid lines.

frame_colour, frame_width

Frame around the matrix.

pad

Extra space beyond the outer dots, in row and column units.

row_colours

Named colours of row annotation boxes.

row_box

Box geometry c(left, width, height) in column units, left measured from the centre of the first column.

column_angle, column_size, column_pad

Column label rotation (degrees), size and distance from the matrix (points).

row_size, row_pad

Row label size (points) and distance from the matrix (points).

colourbar

Optional list: box (c(left, bottom, width, height) in panel fractions), title, breaks, labels, tick_size, title_size.

size_key

Optional list: values (sizes shown), at (panel fractions of the first key dot), step (panel fraction between dots), fill, label_dx (panel fraction from dot to label), title, title_at, size (text points), suffix (default "%").

texts

Optional texts at panel fractions (list of label, xy, size, colour, bold, hjust, vjust, angle); labels may use FormatTemplate() placeholders filled from values.

values

Optional data frame for text templates.

style

A ManuscriptStyle() object.

Value

A 'ggplot2' object.

Examples

d <- expand.grid(row = c("a", "b", "c"), column = c("m1", "m2"), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
d$size <- c(90, 10, 40, 5, 70, 20)
d$signal <- c(2, -1, 0.5, -2, 1.5, 0)
PlotDotMatrix(d)
